closing: 3Blue1Brown explains the mechanism through one example, a single network where it seems fixed instead of something you can control. TensorFlow Playground instead lets you watch training happen live on 2D datasets, where you can actually see the decisions, you make and reshape the output in real time. It also you to train while experimenting. The video teaches why the math should work, while the Playground lets you discover and interact to see when and how it doesn't.
